description: Production-Based CO2 Intensity and Consumption-Based CO2 Intensity Belgium (Historical) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. This dataset contains the production-based CO2 intensity and the consumption-based CO2 intensity for Belgium. The production-based CO2 intensity refers to the amount of carbon dioxide equivalents emitted per unit of generated electricity and is expressed in gCO2eq/kWh. Cross-border flows are not taken into account in the calculation. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Power generation. Its keywords are CO2 Intensity, Historical. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
